(Currently amended) [[The method of claim 15,]] __A method of selecting a first server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising:__ accessing a second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __the information being a unique signature associated with a media request,__ the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selecting is performed by a media request broker.__
